messages: Disha P: Quick heads-up — noticed an accessibility/UX regression with glossary deep-links in the Console docs panel. If the panel is collapsed and you open a deep link (e.g. from an email), the page scrolls but keyboard focus does not land on the term and screen readers don't announce the section. :eyes: Matt R: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste repro steps? I can try to repro on staging. Disha P: Steps: 1) Collapse the right-side docs panel; 2) Click an external link to https://console.redwood.ai/docs#batching; 3) page jumps to batching anchor but pressing Tab goes to header nav, not the anchor. Happens on Chrome + NVDA and Safari + VoiceOver. Ana K: This smells like missing focus management after hashchange. We used to run: window.location.hash && document.getElementById(hash).focus() but that was removed in the last panel refactor. Sam L: Confirmed. On staging I see the anchor has tabindex=-1 but the panel toggle steals focus when it animates open. Quick hack: delay focus until animationend. But we should do it in an a11y-safe way (announce via aria-live?). Matt R: Sketch of fix: when location.hash changes, if element exists then call el.setAttribute('tabindex','-1'); el.focus({preventScroll:true}); then scrollIntoView({behavior:'auto', block:'center'}) once panel is expanded. Need to guard against race conditions with CSS transitions. Disha P: Also, copy consistency issue: the glossary uses "batching" in-console but docs/SDK call it "request batching" in a couple places. Ana can we normalize to the shorter term in the Console and add a crosslink to docs where we expand the concept? Ana K: Yes — propose this flow: keep Console term as "batching", canonicalize in the docs glossary page to accept both labels. Add an inline admon in the SDK docs linking back: "See Console: batching". I'll update the glossary entry and add a redirect alias in the doc frontmatter. Sam L: UX note: if we add an in-panel crosslink, prefer an anchor that opens the panel and move focus into the panel content, not the toggle. Example markup suggestion: ```html batching ``` And JS: listen for data-open-docs-panel, open panel, then focus the anchor target. Also set aria-live region for a short announcement: "Docs panel opened — navigating to glossary entry 'batching'" Matt R: Will PR the focus/animation guard tonight. Sam/Ana can we agree on the aria string so it's consistent across entries? Suggested: "Opened docs panel: glossary — " (short and predictable). Ana K: Agreed. I'll add a note in the docs style guide (glossary section) about the exact phrasing and the recommended link pattern. Also will add a sidenote for product copy: keep the Console label as the primary term and use the longer form in SDK docs where we need clarity. Disha P: Awesome. One more thing — keyboard users expect Shift+Tab to go back into the main content when the panel closes. Make sure our focus restoration sets focus back to the element that triggered the link, not the panel toggle. Matt R: Good call. I'll add focus restoration in the PR. deploy-bot: build/staging succeeded for branch fix/docs-deeplink-176995. Disha P: Thanks everyone — assigning follow-ups: @Matt R (frontend PR for focus/animation), @Ana K (glossary copy + style guide note), @Sam L (aria-live phrasing + implementation pattern). I'll check again after deploy. :thumbsup:
